title: Decent hooks
text:
Decent hooks. bought this in the hopes we could make them work on our drywall mantle.
Unfortunately we could not because our mantle is too big. Daughter in law didn't want them so we used them on our book racks for hanging dog stockings and a few other items. Worked well there.
You need to measure your mantle before buying, to save you a bit of grief.
the hooks are strong, concept is good, but unless there is weight on the hook (more than just a plain stocking) they will shift around.
